# Sanitized Claude Code fixtures

These files are schema-shaped examples based on the official Claude Code hooks
reference reviewed for P7-S4. They are not recordings and do not prove that a
specific installed release emits every field.

They contain placeholders only. Do not replace placeholders with source
contents, prompts, command text, tool responses, transcripts, credentials, or
real local paths. A future adapter must discard content-bearing fields after
extracting any allowed root-confined metadata.
